recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy studio portrait of a shirtless man with an afro and sunglasses captured in a mid-air tuck jump, centered against a stark white background with ultra-thin geometric typography framing the figure.
coreVisualRelationships: Dynamic central figure floating in negative space
Contrast between organic human form and rigid geometric type
Symmetry of the jump pose balanced by asymmetrical text placement
Vibrant patchwork textures against a sterile white environment
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no visible floor line
Subject in a symmetrical mid-air tuck position
High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle horizontal third of the frame, scaled to allow significant white space above and below.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's head and torso form the primary anchor, with the legs tucked beneath creating a compact visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down to the subject's face, follows the outstretched arms, and descends to the stacked text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the left and right margins and between the subject and the text blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with medium-to-high saturation in the clothing patches to create a pop effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two distinct blocks to create vertical symmetry.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s geometric aesthetic and circular 'O's.
Provides the necessary geometric precision and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio photograph of a man with an afro and sunglasses, shirtless, wearing colorful patchwork denim jeans and green sneakers, jumping in a symmetrical tuck position against a seamless, bright white background. Lighting should be even and bright.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a hairline geometric sans-serif. Place one line at the top, split by the subject's head. Place three lines of stacked text at the bottom, centered horizontally, starting just below the subject's feet.

verificationChecks: Is the font weight extremely thin?
Is the subject's pose symmetrical and mid-air?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any trademarked logos on the sneakers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's body.
Check that the 'O' characters are perfectly round.
Verify the lighting is consistent across the subject.
Confirm the background is a flat, shadowless white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dynamic central figure + Hairline geometric sans-serif + High-key white negative space = 1970s minimalist funk aesthetic.
